meta.title: 分布式事务，几种方案到底怎么选？
meta.style: Chaptered comparison of 2PC/XA, Seata AT, TCC, Saga and reliable messages; progressive concrete state changes, explicit branch resets and transaction boundaries.
meta.userScope: Five common engineering routes; latest user request supersedes the old two-term scope; not a market ranking.
